sentence: This project studies how low oxygen changes the metabolism of pregnant deer mice and how that affects birth weight and fetal growth.
This project builds a compact circuit that lets sensors without batteries send signals wirelessly, including neuronal voltages and MRI images.
This project studies how water, sediment, and nutrients move from land to rivers, using river sensors and a deep learning model.
This project tries to solve open problems about Boolean functions, which are used to study how computers work out answers.
This project helps community colleges teach the skills that manufacturing technicians need, including how to work with artificial intelligence.
This project builds tiny soft robots that swim and handle objects in fluids by changing their own mechanical properties.
This project moves a public website that holds a dictionary of English words grouped by meaning to cloud hosting.
This project builds computer methods that learn how linked factory sites normally interact so they can detect hidden cyberthreats.
This project uses computer simulations and lab tests to study how proteins that bind microtubules change the shape of microtubules in neurons.
This project studies how carbonate minerals in dryland soils control the movement of water, nutrients, salts, and carbon.
This project uses a special microscope to study how superconducting materials let current flow more easily in one direction, at the atomic scale.
This project designs extended reality tools and tests whether they raise interest in cybersecurity among rural English learners.
This project studies whether chemical reaction networks stay stable when their surroundings change at random.
This project links how fire spreads across large areas to how it moves through communities and houses, to improve models of fire risk.
This project builds augmented reality systems that read a person's physical surroundings and create helpful visual content placed into the real space.
This project builds ways to train and run language models efficiently and securely across a national network of shared computers.
